title: Postgres primary host
summary: Primary Postgres server hostname and version
body: The primary database is db-prim-01.internal running Postgres 15.4 on port 5432. Applications connect directly; there is no pooler in front of it yet.

title: Postgres read replica
summary: Read replica used for reporting queries
body: Reporting reads go to db-repl-01.internal. Alert fires when replication lag exceeds 30s. Never run migrations against it.

title: Redis session cache
body: Sessions live in redis-sess.internal:6379 with maxmemory 2gb and allkeys-lru eviction. Nothing else should write to this instance.

title: CI runner pool
body: Self-hosted GitHub Actions runners: 8 machines labelled lf-linux, hosted on Hetzner. Jobs that need Docker must use the lf-linux label.

title: Incident on-call rotation
summary: Who is on call and when handoff happens
body: Weekly handoff on Monday at 10:00 CET. Primary on-call is Ines, secondary is Tomas. Swaps are agreed in #oncall and noted in PagerDuty.

title: Release freeze policy
body: No production deploys on Friday after 14:00 local time. Hotfixes need approval from the engineering manager.

title: Frontend build tooling
summary: Bundler, package manager and node version for web
body: The web frontend builds with Vite 5, uses pnpm 9 as package manager and node 20. Lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml and must be committed.

title: Design tokens repo
summary: Where design tokens live and how they ship
body: Tokens live at github.com/lumenfold/tokens and are published to npm as @lumenfold/tokens. Designers edit them in Figma and a bot opens the PR.

title: Terraform state backend
body: Terraform state is in the S3 bucket lf-tfstate with a DynamoDB lock table named lf-tflock. Never run apply from a laptop.

title: VPN access
summary: How to reach internal services remotely
body: Remote access uses WireGuard. The config is generated at vpn.lumenfold.io after you file an IT ticket. Keys rotate every 90 days.

title: Staging environment URL
summary: Address of the staging web app
body: Staging is at https://stg.lumenfold.io behind basic auth. The shared credentials are in the 1Password vault Eng.

title: Production environment URL
summary: Address of the production web app
body: Production is at https://app.lumenfold.io. Status page is status.lumenfold.io.

title: Customer support SLA
body: First response within 4 business hours for Pro customers and within 1 business day for Free customers. Breaches are reported weekly.

title: Data retention policy
summary: How long each data class is kept
body: Application logs are kept 30 days, analytics events 13 months and database backups 35 days. Deletion jobs run nightly.

title: Feature flag service
body: Unleash is self-hosted at flags.lumenfold.io. Each environment has its own SDK key; frontends use the proxy endpoint.

title: Error tracking
body: Errors go to Sentry, organisation lumenfold, with projects web, api and mobile. Alerts post to #alerts-eng.

title: Metrics dashboards
body: Grafana is at grafana.lumenfold.io. The important dashboards are in the folder Core SLOs: latency, error rate, saturation.

title: Email provider
body: Transactional email is sent through Postmark. The from address is no-reply@lumenfold.io; marketing mail uses a different tool.

title: Payment processor
body: Payments run on Stripe. The webhook endpoint is /hooks/stripe and the pinned API version is 2023-10-16. Refunds are issued from the dashboard.

title: Auth service
body: Keycloak 23 at auth.lumenfold.io, realm lumenfold. Access token lifetime is 15 minutes, refresh tokens last 8 hours.

title: Coding style: Python
summary: Formatting and typing rules for Python
body: Use ruff with line length 100 and format with black. Type hints are required in new modules. Docstrings only where behaviour is not obvious.

title: Coding style: TypeScript
body: Strict mode everywhere, no default exports, and the shared eslint config package must be used. Avoid enums; prefer union types.

title: Git branching convention
body: Trunk-based development. Branches are short-lived and named feat/<ticket>-slug. Pull requests are squash merged into main.

title: Sprint cadence
body: Two-week sprints starting on Wednesday. Planning is Wednesday 11:00 and the retro happens on the last Tuesday of the sprint.

title: Team standup
body: Daily standup at 09:45 on Google Meet. Written notes go to #eng-standup for people who cannot attend.

title: Office wifi
body: The HQ network is lumenfold-hq. The guest network password changes every month and IT posts it in #office on the first working day.

title: Laptop policy
body: New hires get a MacBook Pro 14. FileVault must be on and devices are enrolled in Kandji MDM. Lost devices are reported to IT within an hour.

title: Berlin office address
body: Rosenthaler Str. 40, 10178 Berlin, 3rd floor. The door code is given at reception on the first day.

title: Cloud cost budget
body: The monthly AWS budget is 18k USD. A budget alert goes to #finops at 80 percent of the limit.

title: Docker base images
summary: Approved base images and rebuild policy
body: Use python:3.12-slim and node:20-alpine as bases. Images are pinned by digest and rebuilt weekly by the base-images workflow.

title: Kubernetes cluster prod
body: EKS cluster lf-prod in eu-central-1 on Kubernetes 1.29 with 12 m6i.large nodes. Ingress is nginx; cert-manager issues certificates.

title: Kubernetes cluster staging
body: EKS cluster lf-stg in eu-central-1 on Kubernetes 1.29 with 3 nodes. It is scaled to zero on weekends.

title: Load test results
body: The checkout API sustained 1200 rps with a p95 of 180 ms in the March run, using 6 pods and a warm cache.

title: Q3 roadmap
body: Q3 priorities in order: self-serve onboarding, SSO for Business customers, then usage-based billing. Mobile redesign is out of scope.

title: Pricing tiers
body: Plans are Free, Pro at 29 EUR per month and Business at 99 EUR per month. Annual billing gives two months free.

title: Alertmanager routing
body: Critical alerts page the PagerDuty service LF-Core. Warning alerts go to a Slack channel only and never page anyone.

title: PagerDuty escalation
body: If the primary does not acknowledge within 15 minutes the page goes to the secondary, then to the engineering manager after 30 minutes.

title: Backup restore drill
body: The restore drill runs quarterly. The last drill was in August and a full restore took 42 minutes.

title: Notification service
body: A Go service that sends push through FCM and APNs. Work is queued in the SQS queue notif-q and failed sends are retried 5 times.

title: Image resizer lambda
body: An AWS Lambda on arm64 using sharp. Max input is 25 MB and output is webp. Triggered by S3 uploads in the media bucket.

title: Search relevance tuning
body: Product search uses BM25 with a title boost of 3 and a recency decay over 30 days. Tuning changes need an offline eval run first.

title: Onboarding checklist
body: Day one: accounts and laptop. Day two: repository access and local setup. Day three: ship a first small pull request.

title: Editor preferences
summary: How the user likes their editor set up
body: Prefers 2-space indentation, vim keybindings and a dark theme. Dislikes auto-format on save for Markdown files.

title: Kundendienst Zeiten
body: Der Kundendienst ist Montag bis Freitag von 8 bis 17 Uhr erreichbar. Ausserhalb dieser Zeiten laeuft nur der Notfallkontakt.

title: Rechnungsstellung Konfiguration
body: Rechnungen werden als RE-2024-xxxxx nummeriert, die Mehrwertsteuer betraegt 19 Prozent und das Zahlungsziel ist 30 Tage.

title: Deploiement Lyon
summary: Serveur et horaire de deploiement a Lyon
body: Le serveur lyon-app-02 heberge l'application pour le bureau de Lyon. Le deploiement a lieu le jeudi a 18h.

title: Analytics warehouse
body: Analytics runs on BigQuery, project lf-analytics, dataset prod_events. Access is granted through the analysts Google group.

title: dbt project
body: Models live in lumenfold/dbt-models and run hourly through the Airflow DAG dbt_hourly. Failures post to #data-alerts.

title: Airflow deployment
body: Airflow 2.8 on Kubernetes with DAGs synced from git. The web UI is at airflow.lumenfold.io behind SSO.

title: Security contact
body: Report issues to security@lumenfold.io. The disclosure policy is published at /.well-known/security.txt. PGP key id is 0xA1B2C3D4.

title: API client SDKs
body: Python SDK lumenfold-py version 1.4.2 on PyPI and the JavaScript SDK @lumenfold/sdk version 2.0.1 on npm.

title: Nimbus billing API
body: Base URL is https://billing.lumenfold.io/v2. Authentication uses a bearer token read from Vault path secret/billing. Default request timeout is 10 seconds.

title: Nimbus billing API rate limits
summary: Rate limiting of the billing API
body: The billing API allows 600 requests per minute per key. Exceeding it returns 429 with a Retry-After header.

title: Sundial cron scheduler
body: Sundial runs the nightly database backup at 02:30 UTC and ships the dump to the lf-backups bucket.

title: Marrow search cluster
body: Elasticsearch 8.11 with three nodes named mrw-es-1 to mrw-es-3. Index lifecycle policy rolls over weekly.

title: Orchard mobile app
body: Orchard is built with React Native 0.74. The iOS bundle id is com.lumenfold.orchard and releases go through TestFlight first.

title: Gantry deploy tool
body: Gantry is the internal CLI used to roll out services. Config sits in gantry.toml and the default region is eu-west-1.

title: Quillbot Slack assistant
body: A Python bot on Fly.io exposing the /quill slash command. Marit owns it; it summarises threads and looks up runbooks.

title: Tidewater ingest pipeline
body: A Rust Kafka consumer that reads topic ingest.raw and writes parquet files to the S3 bucket tw-lake-prod. Owned by data-platform.

title: Repository housekeeping
body: Dependabot runs on Monday. Branches older than 60 days are deleted by a scheduled workflow, except those labelled keep.

title: Accessibility standard
summary: Accessibility target for the web app
body: The web app targets WCAG 2.1 AA. New components need keyboard navigation tests and an axe check in CI.

title: Localization workflow
body: Strings are extracted with i18next-parser and translated in Lokalise. English and German ship first; French follows one sprint later.

title: API documentation
body: OpenAPI specs are generated from the code and rendered with Redoc at docs.lumenfold.io/api. The spec is checked in CI for breaking changes.
